subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender textos expositivos de divulgação científica para crianças, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/ assunto do texto.

components.description_en: Identify the topic and subject of expository science popularization texts written for children
components.cc_component_description: Determine the main topic or subject of a scientific informational text

components.description_pt: Compreender informações apresentadas em textos infantis de divulgação científica
components.description_en: Comprehend information presented in children's science popularization texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify supporting details from a text read aloud or information presented in diverse media

components.description_pt: Reconhecer situação comunicativa e propósito de textos infantis de divulgação científica

components.cc_component_description: Identify the main purpose of an informational text

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret scientific informational texts by
* Determining what text is about
* Defining or classifying a concept or entity
Identify the main purpose of a text, including what the author wants to answer, explain, or describe.
Determine the main ideas and supporting details of a text read aloud or information presented in diverse media and formats, including visually, quantitatively, and orally.
